prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. A four-asset illustration sheet for Android FitnessApp, exercise Sentadilla con barra (quads_barbell_back_squat). EXACT FOUR EQUAL PANELS, STRICT 2x2 grid with perfectly centered vertical and horizontal division. No borders, no margins, NO TEXT NO LABELS NO NUMBERS NO LOGOS. Upper-left movement initial position; upper-right middle of movement; lower-left final contraction/end range; lower-right muscle map. The first three panels show same realistic adult athlete, same modest charcoal sleeveless gym top and shorts, same camera angle and same equipment; three clearly DIFFERENT poses to explain the motion. Choose three-quarter SIDE view that makes the movement and joint angles unmistakable. All relevant limbs and equipment fully inside each panel, normal five-finger hands, plausible equipment and joints. Dark studio background #121416, warm soft champagne rim light, consistent photorealistic 3D educational illustration, realistic light loads. Setup: En un rack con topes de seguridad, coloca la barra sobre la parte alta de la espalda, no sobre el cuello. Saca la barra y separa los pies a la anchura de los hombros. Sequence technique: Toma aire, tensa el abdomen y baja doblando cadera y rodillas. Mantén el pecho alto y el peso repartido en todo el pie. Baja hasta la profundidad que controles sin redondear la espalda. Sube empujando el suelo con la cadera y el pecho a la vez. Show EXACT named variant and equipment, not a substitute movement. Do not merge multiple athletes in a movement panel. No arrows inside frames. Bottom-right panel contains two faceless medical teaching mannequins front and back in opaque gray sports suits with colored muscle overlays, with accurately bounded colored muscles, no glow, no heatmap. Primary quadriceps femoris pale champagne on FRONT thighs. Gluteus maximus secondary muted amber for squat, split squat and leg press. For isolated leg extension only quadriceps highlighted. Primary color #D8C3A5; secondary #A77B47; unworked skin/muscles gray. Other figures and diagrams must not intrude in movement panels. Four assets will be cropped into independent rectangular images. Keep composition centered with 5% breathing room within EACH quadrant. Avoid decorative text, incorrect cable attachment, floating handles, disconnected weights. Instructional visual draft, not diagnosis.
